name: Zuari Industries Ltd
title: Zuari Industries Ltd - 500780 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record sugar crush of 159.7 lakh quintal and 101.7% utilisation, but holding-company debt guided down ~INR1,200 crore to ~INR700 crore via Dubai and associate inflows, which management has promised for several quarters.

utilisation.quote: we achieved the highest ever capacity utilization of 101.7%

capex.peers_comment: Management said ethanol overcapacity is about 100%, with bids of about 1,800 crore litres against 1,050 crore litres of OMC tenders; ZEBPL expansion plans put on hold.
capex.quote: we have put those expansion plans on hold

triggers.label: Ethanol expansion plans put on hold
triggers.quote: we have put those expansion plans on hold, and we are first trying to stabilize the investment

triggers.label: Sugar utilisation 101.7%, record
triggers.quote: we achieved the highest ever capacity utilization of 101.7%

triggers.label: Net debt ~INR700 cr by year-end
triggers.quote: we will be standing at a position of around INR700 crores as at the end of the year

triggers.label: Ethanol overcapacity ~100%
triggers.quote: So it's almost like a 100% over capacity currently in ethanol

triggers.label: OMC second/third-round tenders not yet out
triggers.quote: the OMC tenders which are supposed to come the second and the third round have not come yet

guidance.quote: we will be standing at a position of around INR700 crores as at the end of the year

guidance.value: INR850-900 crore over next six months
guidance.quote: about INR850 crores to INR900 crores should flow into us over the next six months
the inflows from our associate company of around INR258 crores

red_flags.label: Repeated deleveraging timeline slippage
red_flags.quote: last one, two quarters I've been hearing that this will be deleveraged every quarter

red_flags.label: Investment value down ~20%
red_flags.quote: the value of all your investments have gone down by 20%, which is around INR1,000 crores

red_flags.label: Texmaco provision
red_flags.quote: They have just made a provision of INR700 crores in their balance sheet

red_flags.label: Ethanol overcapacity and no OMC tenders
red_flags.quote: the OMC tenders which are supposed to come the second and the third round have not come yet

evasions.quote: We do not comment on the share prices.

evasions.topic: Texmaco Rail provision and Delhi project
evasions.quote: I think that question is best asked to that company -- Texmaco Infra Holdings.
